Antwoorden op @maloiyvesricalde6 Do you love the rich, velvety taste of dark Belgian chocolate as much as I do? 🍫💚 Because today’s ASMR mukbang was all about savoring a bar of heavenly dark Belgian chocolate with pistachios, and it was everything! 😍 It had been way too long since I last enjoyed this treat, and the combination of smooth, intense chocolate and crunchy, buttery pistachios was pure bliss in every bite. 🤤✨ Dark chocolate has always been one of my all-time favorite desserts, and this one really brought back all the feels! 💖 The textures, the flavors, and that perfect snap as I bit into it—it was all just chef’s kiss. 😋🍴 I'm beyond grateful for all of your support and love. RECIPE :  On prépare ensemble du chocolat de communion martiniquais! - Recette NON EXHAUSTIVE ! We prepare a eucharist chocolate together. It’s a non-exhaustive recipe! Temps de cuisson approximatif : 30 min. Approximate cooking time: 30 min. ⬇️(pour environ 10 bonnes tasses) - (for about 10 cops of chocolaté) 400 g de lait demi écrémé (400 g of semi-skimmed milk) 410 g de lait concentré non sucré (410 g of unsweetened condensed milk) 370 g de lait concentré sucré (370 g of sweetened condensed milk) 1 tablette de chocolat noir, d’environ 200 g (1 bar of dark chocolate, approximately 200 g) 1 C à soupe de beurre de cacahuète (1 tablespoon of peanut butter) Arôme amande amère (Bitter almond flavor) Arôme vanille (Vanilla flavor) Batons de cannelle (Cinnamon sticks) 1 Verre d’eau (1 Glass of water) Zestes de citron (Lemon zest) 20g  de « Pudding powder » saveur chocolat, pour épaissir légèrement (20g of chocolate flavored “Pudding powder”, to thicken slightly) Le tout doit se cuire sur un petit feu. Everything must be cooked over a low heat.
